payload.reason: The evidence provides specific downstream tasks analyzed in the context of DistilBERT's performance, including sentiment classification and question answering, as well as evaluation on the GLUE benchmark.

claims.text: The downstream tasks analyzed include IMDb sentiment classification and SQuAD v1.1 question answering.
DistilBERT was evaluated on the General Language Understanding Evaluation (GLUE) benchmark, which consists of 9 datasets for natural language understanding.
